source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Corvette Body, p.1B-29

procedures.title: Scratched panels, spot refinishing
steps: Refinish the panel following the paint refinishing part of the manual.

procedures.title: Dents or pits in panels, cracks in glaze coat
steps: Strip paint around the damage down to the plastic with Lacquer Removing Solvent or equivalent.
Scuff the surrounding area so the repair bonds well.
Clean the work area with Prep-Sol, then finish with a tack rag.
notes: For a heavy glancing blow that leaves a dent or large pit (see figure 64 in the manual), and for cracks in the glaze/finish coat.
Use only where damage is limited and the plastic is not pierced but needs building up.
Figure 48 (spare tire mount) and figure 49 (rear grille and air door) also appear on this page.
